home.heroTitle: Study smarter together with a document library and AI

blocks.title: Smart document library
blocks.desc: Storage optimized for academics, helping you organize thousands of documents in seconds.
bullets: Upload multiple formats (PDF, DOCX, PPTX) with large capacity.
Automatic categorization by subject and smart tagging.
Deep search of content inside every document page.

blocks.title: Ask AI HiveMind
blocks.desc: An AI companion that understands your documents and answers instantly.
bullets: Ask questions directly based on specific document content.
Summarize long chapters into concise key points.
Suggest review questions based on the knowledge in the file.

blocks.title: Sharing community
blocks.desc: Learn together and curate the best sources from the community.
bullets: Rate and review documents from trusted users.
Save public documents to your personal library in one tap.

blocks.title: Storage Spaces
blocks.desc: Create a dedicated space for each term or topic and study together with friends.
bullets: Create separate spaces for each term or topic.
Share an entire Space with friends to study together.
Track reading and study progress in each space.

howItWorks.title: How HiveMind works
howItWorks.subtitle: Optimize your study workflow with the support of artificial intelligence. Simple, effective and designed for modern learners.

steps.title: Upload documents
steps.desc: Upload any study document format: PDF, DOCX, or lecture images. HiveMind automatically extracts the content and gets it ready to process.

steps.title: Categorize by subject
steps.desc: The system suggests a suitable subject for your document. Organize your own knowledge base in the most structured way.

steps.title: Share with the community
steps.desc: Connect with the knowledge hive. Share your documents or reference documents from thousands of other learners to broaden your perspective.

steps.title: Ask AI about document content
steps.desc: Chat directly with your documents. Ask for summaries, explanations of difficult concepts, or self-test questions.

about.title: About HiveMind

values.title: Creative

values.title: Connected

values.title: Efficient

about.teamSubtitle: The dedicated people behind the HiveMind project.
about.missionText: HiveMind was born from a simple desire to simplify learning in the information age. We believe that with the help of AI, every student can build a smart knowledge “hive”, where every document is organized scientifically and easy to leverage.
